items.name: Evanston Qualifier 2025
items.information: **3x3 will *not* be held at this competition!** This competition provides one last chance to set qualifying times for the [WCA World Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2025) in July. Please read all tabs before registering. A music festival (Dillo Day) will take place at Northwestern on Saturday. Parking and traffic may be worse than usual, particularly during and after lunch, so please plan accordingly. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVZoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1b3d9004e1f9dfdbe319a8f4bd8117aa0a47de6b/image.png)

items.name: Finnish FMC Series VII 2025
items.information: **This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.** Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. **Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.** Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Sörmland Open 2025

venue.name: Amazon
venue.details: Enter from the back, on the hill.

items.information: Välkomna till Sörmland Open 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** På fredagen hålls endast ett försök 3x3 Multi-BLD. Om du inte tävlar i den grenen behöver du inte komma redan på fredagen, utan det räcker att du kommer först innan din första gren ska börja på lördagen. ----- Welcome to Sörmland Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: St. Louishh 2025

venue.name: [Trinity Church Kirkwood](https://trinitychurchkirkwood.org)
venue.address: 1110 S Glenwood Ln, St. Louis, MO 63122

items.information: **Note: This Competition is held on a Friday. This compeition is not recommended for first time competitors. Check out [St. Louis Spring 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StLouisSpring2025) for a more beginner friendly competition.** This competition will be held in the Sanctuary, which is the big room in the middle of the venue. Restrooms are in the hallway adjacent to the nurseries. This competition is sponsored by the [Midwest Cubing Association!](https://www.midwestcubing.org) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzczNjEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cd1fe78172715dfab6b41f0fce0fd3a5e0e4020e/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)
